subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require a focused current-main Windows/WSL repro before choosing between a tsdown update/pin/wrapper fix and a broader rollback to tsc?
rationale: The issue has credible screenshot evidence of the wrapper hanging, but the requested solution changes the build system and cannot be chosen safely without maintainer intent and platform proof.

options.title: Require focused Windows/WSL repro first
options.body: Run or request first-build and second-build logs on current main before deciding whether the fix belongs in tsdown dependency selection, the wrapper, or a rollback.

options.title: Treat as beta-blocking build-tool work now
options.body: Prioritize a maintainer-led build-tool investigation immediately and accept that the fix direction may be chosen before full platform proof is captured.

options.title: Defer pending reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for full logs or a minimal repro because the current evidence does not isolate dependency behavior from local source checkout state.

recommendation.title: Require focused Windows/WSL repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request first-build and second-build logs on current main before deciding whether the fix belongs in tsdown dependency selection, the wrapper, or a rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on Windows and tsdown wrapper process handling.
